messages.content: Summarize the text in one sentence of at most 25 words. Plain text only, no preamble, no bullet points.

At 09:12 UTC the primary database ran out of disk after a log rotation job failed silently for six days. Writes were rejected for 41 minutes until an engineer expanded the volume. We are adding a disk-usage alert and a check that the rotation job actually ran.

response.text: A log rotation job failed silently for six days, causing writes to be rejected for 41 minutes.
